| # Occurrence Counter, Sub-function 0x06 {#occurrence-counter-sub-function-0x06-1 .p_Heading1 style="page-break-after: avoid;"}                                                                                                                                                                                    |                                                                                                                                                                       |
+-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+

The sub-function 0x02 - reportDTCExtDataRecordByDTCNumber allows the client to retrieve captured DTCExtendedData record(s) associated with a DTC.

Key data retrieved here is occurrence counter of DTC.
